dog.description_text:
With her striking striped coat, expressive eyes, and affectionate personality, Kimchi is ready to find the loving home she deserves. She may take a little time to warm up, but once she trusts you, she'll happily become your shadow, filling your days with purrs, conversation, and companionship.

Kimchi loves being pet, enjoys playtime with her toys, and isn't shy about letting you know when she's ready for attention. She came to ARF through our Operation Cat program and is thriving with simple daily B12 supplements that help manage her IBD. Like many cats, she has her preferences, and salmon is at the top of her menu.

If you're looking for a sweet, loyal companion with plenty of charm and personality, Kimchi is ready to curl up beside you and make herself part of the family.
